title: Harmonize cost-card density, iconography, and localized layouts for WCAG & keyboard readiness
creator: Maya Chen
description: Consolidate the cost card UI across dashboards and rollout lists so that density toggles, iconography, and localized numeric/date formatting meet WCAG AA and keyboard navigation expectations. Deliver updated Figma prototypes, dev specs, and an acceptance test plan. This work addresses recurring accessibility issues from internal audits and customer reports about RTL truncation, insufficient contrast on token totals, and inaccessible density control widgets.
background: Recent accessibility sweep flagged inconsistent focus order and several visual failures in the cost views: small token totals with contrast below 4.5:1, density switch implemented with only color change, and locale formatting causing overflow in narrow layouts (esp. fr_FR & ar_SA). Product wants a single, testable pattern for cost-cards used in Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost Explorer to simplify dev QA and internationalization.
acceptance_criteria: All visible text meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast thresholds (>= 4.5:1 for body text, >= 3:1 for UI components where appropriate).
Density control is operable by keyboard, has an accessible label, and does not rely on color alone to convey state.
When locale is set to fr_FR, de_DE, zh_CN and ar_SA, numbers and dates do not overflow the card; truncation uses accessible ellipses with full-value aria tooltip.
Focus order across card controls (primary action, secondary action, density toggle, more menu) matches visual reading order and is preserved in RTL.
Iconography scales with user font-size settings and uses semantic aria-hidden or aria-labels where appropriate.
Unit tests + visual regression snapshots cover major breakpoints including narrow mobile and RTL.
test_plan: Manual QA: run accessibility checklist in Axe and VoiceOver/JAWS on sample dashboards with localized data (en_US, fr_FR, ar_SA).
Automated: add contrast checks to CI for changed color tokens and run Puppeteer snapshot tests for LTR/RTL renderings.
Keyboard smoke: tab through the cost-card at 3 breakpoints and record focus order and visible focus rings.
I18n: verify number grouping, decimal separators, currency placement, and month names for sample locales using locale test harness.
decisions: Adopt 'compact', 'comfortable' density tokens with consistent padding values across cost card variants to reduce dev variance.
Use semantic color tokens: text-primary, text-muted, ui-border, and accent-strong; update accent-strong contrast to meet 4.5:1 on light backgrounds.
Density control will be a segmented control (role='tablist') with explicit aria-pressed attributes and icons + labels to avoid color-only differentiation.
For RTL, switch to end-aligned numeric layout and ensure ellipsis placement does not hide leading currency symbols for locales that place symbols on the left.
